messages.subject: using jQuery on a table
parts:
I have a table that I want to execute some jQuery on, but the tableid is actually a div in the source code of the webpage, and it fails. 

For example... 

$(document).ready( function () {
    $('#table_id').dataTable();
} );

If I make a table explicitly as html in R and use renderUI() in my server.R and uiOutput in my ui.R file, I can see my table... but looking at the source code of the page, my table id is used in a div, so I can't run dataTable stuff on it. 

I know there's dataTable support now in Shiny, but I'm trying to integrate https://github.com/ksavin/SelectableRows with dataTables and running into problems, so I thought I'd just do it all manually.

Thanks
